paper.title_en: Gravitational waves from a binary source in higher dimensional spacetime with compactified extra dimensions
paper.abstract_en: We consider the emission of gravitational waves (GW) from a compact binary in a spacetime with compactified extra dimensions. We solve the homogeneous and non-homogeneous wave equation, proving that there is an infinite sum of exponentially decaying pseudo-massive modes which add to the usual one which behaves as 1/r at infinity. We calculate the metric potentials, the equations of motion and the energy flux. We find that in the equations of motion there is a new term at -1PN order. This implies a modification of the energy flux.
